+from __future__ import annotations

+import os

+import numpy as np

+
+

+NAMES = ["whitepackerbottle_a01", "whitepackerbottle_a02", "whitepackerbottle_a03"]
+
+
+def main():
+    s = Session(TASK, instance="/app/instance.json")
+    p = s.primitives()
+    yaw = 0.0
+    q = p["top_down_quat"](yaw)
+    pail = np.asarray(s.objects()["squarepail_a01"]["position"], dtype=float)
+
+    def save_snapshot(meta=None):
+        if s._recording:
+            acts = np.stack(s._recording).astype(np.float32)
+            s.save_trajectory(acts, OUT, meta=meta or {})
+
+    def go(xyz, label, speed=0.18):
+        xyz = np.asarray(xyz, dtype=float)
+        print(f"MOVE {label}: target={np.round(xyz, 4)} start={np.round(s.ee_pose()[0], 4)}", flush=True)
+        err = p["move_ee"](xyz, q, speed=speed, tol=0.007, rot_tol=0.08, max_steps=220, settle=2)
+        print(f"  end={np.round(s.ee_pose()[0], 4)} err={err}", flush=True)
+
+    def contained(name):
+        from robolab.core.task.conditionals import object_in_container
+        return bool(object_in_container(
+            s.env, object=name, container="squarepail_a01",
+            require_gripper_detached=True, env_id=0,
+        ))
+
+    try:
+        print("START", s.status(), flush=True)
+        print("OBJECTS", s.objects(), flush=True)
+        s.record_start()
+        p["open_gripper"](5)
+
+        # Small, separated drop points across the centre of the pail's footprint.
+        drop_x = [-0.052, 0.0, 0.052]
+        for idx, name in enumerate(NAMES):
+            obj = s.objects()[name]
+            pos = np.asarray(obj["position"], dtype=float)
+            lo, hi = np.asarray(obj["bounds"], dtype=float)
+            height = hi[2] - lo[2]
+            # The fingertip frame is at the pad ends; the pad faces extend upward
+            # about 5.7 cm, so descend close to the table to grasp the bottle body.
+            grasp_z = max(0.022, pos[2] + min(0.028, height * 0.36))
+            print(f"\nPICK {name}: pose={np.round(pos,4)} bounds={np.round([lo,hi],4)} grasp_z={grasp_z:.4f}", flush=True)
+            go([pos[0], pos[1], 0.24], f"{name} pregrasp")
+            go([pos[0], pos[1], grasp_z], f"{name} grasp descent", speed=0.12)
+            p["close_gripper"](20)
+            p["hold"](4)
+            go([pos[0], pos[1], 0.25], f"{name} lift", speed=0.12)
+            pos_lift = np.asarray(s.object_pose(name)[0])
+            print(f"  after lift object={np.round(pos_lift,4)} initial={np.round(pos,4)}", flush=True)
+            if pos_lift[2] - pos[2] < 0.025:
+                raise RuntimeError(f"{name} did not lift: {pos_lift}")
+
+            dest = np.array([pail[0] + drop_x[idx], pail[1], 0.30])
+            go(dest, f"{name} carry above pail", speed=0.18)
+            # Lower the held bottle well inside the walls before opening.
+            go([dest[0], dest[1], 0.075], f"{name} lower into pail", speed=0.10)
+            p["open_gripper"](18)
+            p["hold"](28)
+            placed_pos = np.asarray(s.object_pose(name)[0])
+            print(f"  placed object={np.round(placed_pos,4)} contained={contained(name)}", flush=True)
+            save_snapshot({"completed": idx + 1})
+            go([dest[0], dest[1], 0.29], f"{name} retreat", speed=0.12)
+            print("  status", s.status(), flush=True)
+
+        acts = s.record_stop()
+        s.save_trajectory(acts, OUT, meta={"bottles": NAMES, "method": "top-down pinch and low drop"})
+        print("SAVED", OUT, "shape", acts.shape, "status", s.status(), flush=True)
+    except BaseException:
+        traceback.print_exc()
+        if s._recording is not None:
+            acts = s.record_stop()
+            s.save_trajectory(acts, OUT, meta={"partial": True})
+            print("SAVED PARTIAL", OUT, "shape", acts.shape, "status", s.status(), flush=True)
+        raise
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
